title: Soul Feast #57: What’s Real? The New Consciousness
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.

A new consciousness is transforming the human experience –  a shift so vast that it’s redefining what we call “reality.” In this Soul Feast, Gary explores how this unprecedented evolution is dissolving the boundaries of five-sensory perception and awakening humanity to a larger, multisensory reality. He shares vivid personal experiences that illustrate how connection with the nonphysical world – with souls, angels, and divine intelligence – reveals that love is not just an emotion but the very fabric of existence.

As Gary contrasts the old world built on manipulation and fear with the emerging one built on love, cooperation, and reverence for life, he shows how the human story is shifting from survival to spiritual growth. 

Power is no longer defined by control, but by alignment – the alignment of personality with soul. 

Every thought, word, and action is a choice between love and fear – and with awareness, we can now consciously choose love.

The new consciousness calls us to remember who we are: immortal souls creating with the energy of love. As Gary reminds us, what’s real is not what we can weigh or measure – it’s the awareness expanding within us, awakening us to our true power and purpose.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:42) — The profound personal moment that revealed the presence of the nonphysical world
  • (06:56) — What the “new consciousness” means and how it’s transforming human perception
  • (14:56) — Why external power based on control and manipulation leads to destruction — and how authentic power transforms it
  • (18:33) — The difference between love and fear — and how every choice creates either pain or peace
  • (22:04) — How to live from love even amid fear, conflict, or injustice
  • (25:12) — Practical ways to develop emotional awareness and align personality with soul

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take out your Soul Notebook and reflect on the moments that resonated with you in this Soul Feast. Which parts of Gary’s message awakened a sense of recognition, resistance, or curiosity? Write honestly about the choices you’ve made from fear – and the ones you’ve made from love. Each reflection brings you closer to living as a multisensory being, aware that love is what’s real, and it always has been.
